subject.title: improve: show edit mismatch candidate lines

question: After the overlong-line scan guard is fixed, should this PR's candidate-line wording and output shape be the canonical implementation for the edit mismatch diagnostics request?
rationale: Multiple open PRs implement the same user-facing edit mismatch diagnostics, and automation cannot choose the final output contract for maintainers.

options.title: Use this PR after scan fix
options.body: Repair the remaining overlong-line scanner gap here, then treat this branch as the canonical implementation and close or rebase the sibling attempts.

options.title: Prefer a sibling implementation
options.body: Pause this PR and move any useful boundedness tests into the sibling branch with the preferred output contract.

options.title: Ask for one combined branch
options.body: Request a final narrow branch that combines the preferred wording, source-exposure limits, and bounded scanner behavior from the competing PRs.

recommendation.title: Use this PR after scan fix
recommendation.body: Repair the remaining overlong-line scanner gap here, then treat this branch as the canonical implementation and close or rebase the sibling attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete has the strongest history-backed signal for the current agent runtime surface and output-contract choice among the likely owners.
